local_checks.scope: Local checkout advisory only; no homelab or local-model connection. SQL formatting warnings use only code-defined table names; values remain bound parameters.

exercised: Read committed data in a live SQLite WAL through the SQLite backup API.
Preserve versions, owner isolation, quarantine and idempotency receipts after restoring.
Reconcile deletions before/after backup, including keys created and deleted after backup.
Remove forgotten values/revisions/vectors/receipts; preserve replay tombstones; compact only the new file.
Refuse corrupt or incomplete backups, mismatched project/schema, missing or regressed deletion ledgers and existing destinations.
Clean controlled interruptions without removing source directories; CLI returns 130, not success.
CLI backup/restore subprocess roundtrip and structured SQLite errors.
POSIX owner-only output permissions and exclusion of credentials.
limits: No homelab host or two-machine transport was accessed; Windows ACLs/execution remain untested.
The operator must stop writers through cutover and supply the authoritative current deletion ledger; freshness is not attested by the code.
No automatic service activation or replacement of an existing data directory.
Restore does not recover post-backup captures, corrections or reviews.
Backups are plaintext; encryption, off-host retention, scheduling and whole-service disaster recovery are not configured.
Digests detect mismatches; they do not authenticate an attacker-controlled backup plus manifest.
Old snapshots, exported data and agent archives remain outside deletion scope.
